rejected_family_candidates.reason: Counterevidence in the same literature (Vasileiou 2023, Investment Management and Financial Innovations 13(3):388-402: TOM may not beat buy-and-hold on BTC/ETH); mechanism economically weak in perpetuals (no month-end settlement/flow cycle); long-only beta-timing confound weakens the causal control; month-window choice adds researcher multiplicity. Frozen out BEFORE proposal writing.
Proximity to the forbidden weekly-reversal family (naming/mechanism collision risk) and fragile sign-flipping published findings; evidence quality insufficient.

Continuously-held single-asset book produces no completed holding spans in the A3 schedule gate (fail-closed on median intended holding); proximity risk to the reserved low-residual-risk defensive family (risk-managed exposure in spirit).
